title: Pin export directory access against concurrent path replacement
description: Safety review of crates/journal-core/src/export.rs: check_components validates destination ancestors once, but subsequent open_regular, NamedTempFile, read_optional, rename, persist, and directory fsync calls resolve paths again. O_NOFOLLOW protects the final component only. Renaming the selected directory or recovery directory and substituting a symlink after validation can redirect later operations outside the selected destination and detach operations from the locked directory. Scope: anchor operations to verified directory handles with safe relative resolution on supported Linux/macOS, or fail safely without touching a substituted destination. Preserve original journal/export data.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic tests swap destination and recovery directories after validation and before read/write/rename; no outside file is created, modified, or moved and no private output escapes. Lock and manifest operations stay associated with the verified directory. Existing symlink, collision, recovery and external-edit tests continue to pass. State supported-platform and residual race limitations.
close_reason: Completed Unix descriptor-relative export migration and directory-substitution regressions, including entry replacement/recovery; platform and residual-race limitations documented. Linux tests/check pass; macOS release validation remains tracked under sj-kfw.

title: Preserve concurrently modified export manifests during replacement
description: Safety review of crates/journal-core/src/export.rs write_manifest: read_optional checks the manifest before creating/writing/fsyncing a temporary file; temp.persist then unconditionally replaces an existing manifest. An external editor changing the manifest during that interval loses its bytes. Unlike export_one, this path neither retains displaced bytes nor verifies them after displacement. Scope: make manifest replacement detect intervening edits and preserve displaced content, including edits after the final precheck; do not claim filesystem compare-and-swap. Keep receipt recovery and conflict reporting accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic failure-injection tests change the manifest after its precheck and before replacement; external bytes remain available and export reports a conflict instead of claiming success. First-create collisions remain no-clobber. Normal replacement and pending-receipt recovery still pass. Document any crash window and recovery behavior.
close_reason: Manifest overwrite race addressed with retained displacement, conflict detection, no-clobber installation and regression coverage.
